description: Evidence-bounded mobile decision briefs with owner-only decisions, rule impact, and descriptive implementation tracking.

routing.when_to_use: Use for a unique matter requiring evidence, risks, choices, a recommendation, an owner decision record, rule-impact draft, or implementation tracking.
when_not_to_use: Do not approve, activate, enforce, schedule, send, create tasks, or mutate a Program.
Do not replace meeting, time-management, workforce, communication transport, or consumer-owned governance systems.

required_inputs.name: source_evidence
required_inputs.description: Explicit synthetic, redacted, or public evidence

required_inputs.name: mode
required_inputs.description: Decision brief, record, rule impact, or implementation tracking

expected_outputs.name: decision_brief
expected_outputs.description: Mobile-readable evidence and owner-review record with empty effects

forbidden_actions: Approve or activate a decision or governance rule
Create tasks, schedules, meetings, workforce, or Program state
verification_steps: Check unique matter and evidence refs
Require choices and Other — specify for non-exhaustive sets
Confirm authority remains inactive and effects are empty
